verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same problems: 'NEW YORK' has slipped off its navy ribbon and sits on the busy photo, leaving the top ribbon empty. 'SUBWAY'/'GUIDE' shrink into small subordinate tabs, which breaks the original's equal three-bar headline. The sign is cropped to an unreadable 'WA', the grey diagonal stripes end up as stray fragments in mid-canvas, and the bottom half is dead photo.
